messages:
IncBot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: spike in model-quality-failures for route /v1/chat/generate (region: us-west-2). 5xxs + semantic-failure-rate > SLO threshold. Pager sent to oncall.
Alex: oncall here — seeing degraded outputs reported by internal evals and customer incidents. looks like recent model deploy `rw-v2-large-quant@20260201` is suspect.
Mira: copying quick triage: 1) confirm error vector (5xxs vs semantic/regression) 2) isolate traffic via routing pin/canary 3) status page + customer comm draft 4) roll back or pin to stable.
Sam: logs from runtime show: `kv-cache-miss increase` and `runtime-exec-time +30%` around deploy window. Not huge CPU OOMs. Also seeing increased perplexity on our evaluation set. Posting condensed log sample: ```[2026-02-19T22:05:12Z] request_id=abc123 stage=decode latency_ms=210 token_loss=5.8 model=rw-v2-large-quant```.
Priya: I'll take status page + external comm. putting a short status now (draft below).
Priya: ```Status: Degraded service for text-generation in us-west-2. Impact: some queries return erroneous or failed responses; customers may see incorrect outputs or elevated latency. Mitigation: routing to fallback model in progress. ETA for next update: 30 minutes.```.
Taylor: I'll draft a short customer note for affected customers (support + account teams): ```Hi — we're investigating an issue causing degraded output quality for some text-generation requests in us-west-2. We've put mitigations in place (traffic routing to a fallback model) and will follow up with impact details and timeline. If you see critical failures please reply to this thread or open a priority support ticket. — Redwood Inference Ops```
Alex: action list I'm starting now: 1) pin traffic for production tier to `rw-v2-stable-20260115` via routing policy 2) enable fallback to `rw-v1-medium` for small requests 3) run roll-back checklist if pin fails. I'll do (1) now.
Sam: command to pin on routing-controller: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routing/pin -d '{"from":"rw-v2-large-quant","to":"rw-v2-stable-20260115","pct":100,"reason":"auto-mitigation:quality-regression"}'```
DeployBot: executed pin command. Response: `200 OK` routing change applied. New route map: /v1/chat/generate -> rw-v2-stable-20260115 (100%) in us-west-2.
Taylor: :white_check_mark: Good. Can we also publish a short internal summary for CS and Sales so they can proactively reach out? Quick template: ```Internal: Incident 2026-02-19-1897503333. Root cause under investigation: model deploy rw-v2-large-quant. Mitigation: traffic pinned to rw-v2-stable-20260115; fallback policies enabled. Impact: potential incorrect outputs and transient latency increases. Next steps: evaluate quality delta, decide rollback within 90m, notify customers.```.
Mira: I'll run evaluation jobs comparing sample prompts across rw-v2-large-quant vs rw-v2-stable-20260115 and rw-v1-medium. Expect ~15-20m for initial aggregate metrics. Sharing eval command: ```python eval/compare.py --models rw-v2-large-quant,rw-v2-stable-20260115,rw-v1-medium --dataset incidents-smoke-1k --metrics perplexity,qa-f1,toxicity```
Alex: handing off to Mira for the incident lead while I help CS comms. Mira, please take over primary pager handling — provide timeline + next steps.
Mira: taking lead. Current timeline: T+0 (now): routing pin applied. T+15m: first eval results. T+45m: decision point — either full rollback of deploy or keep pinned with a rollout plan. Notify customers at decision.
Priya: status page updated (public): ```We are investigating degraded output quality for text-generation in us-west-2. Mitigation in progress: traffic routed to a stable model. We will provide updates at 15-minute intervals.``` Posted and marked incident: incident-1897503333 in status page system.
Sam: initial evals (10m): rw-v2-large-quant shows 12% regression in QA-F1 vs stable on our alert set and increased hallucination signals. rw-v2-stable and rw-v1-medium perform within baseline.
Mira: conclusion: deploy introduced a quality regression. Recommendation: schedule rollback of rw-v2-large-quant from serving pool and keep pinned until further investigation. Also recommend temporary increase in canary sampling for future deploys.
Alex: agreed. I'll open rollback ticket and trigger rollback playbook. Rollback command (runbooks): ```/runbooks rollback-model --model rw-v2-large-quant --region us-west-2 --reason "quality regression"```
DeployBot: rollback job started. Logs: `depoly-rollback-789 started -> draining instances -> switching model endpoints -> verified 200 OK on health checks`.
Taylor: drafting customer-facing follow-up now. Suggest concise language and offer post-mortem. Template below: ```Customer notice draft: Subject: Incident: degraded text-generation outputs (us-west-2) — Resolved (mitigation applied) Body: Hi <Customer>, earlier today we detected degraded output quality for some text-generation requests in us-west-2 following a model deployment. We routed traffic to a stable model and rolled back the deploy. Impact: some requests between 22:04–22:20 UTC may have returned incorrect results. Mitigation: requests were routed to a verified stable model; no data exfiltration detected. Next steps: we will run a thorough post-mortem and share findings. If you saw any critical failures please reply and we will prioritize. — Redwood Inference Ops```
Priya: posted customer message to support queue and drafted targeted messages for customers with high-risk usages.
Mira: monitoring: error rates and quality metrics back to baseline after rollback and pin. Will keep this thread for final timeline and post-mortem notes.
Alex: handing back to on-call for daytime rotation: Mira -> Alex on next shift at T+4h. For now closing active mitigation actions — Ops please confirm any remaining todos.
Sam: will keep watch on KPIs for 2 hours; running deeper diagnostic on kernel selection and quantization path.
Priya: final public update posted: ```Update: traffic pinned and deploy rolled back. Service returning to normal; we'll follow up with a post-mortem.```
Mira: good work team. Post-mortem owner: Sam. Post-mortem draft ETA: 48 hours. Closing this thread when post-mortem is linked. :raised_hands:
Alex: :thumbsup: thanks all.
